profile.name: Prateek Sharma
profile.summary: Full Stack Developer building cross-platform applications with React, React Native, Flutter, Node.js and TypeScript. I architect SSO systems, write native mobile bridges in Swift and Kotlin, integrate AI services, and ship containerized backends through CI/CD — including a published Play Store app with its own DevOps pipeline.

points: Architected a centralized SSO Client Hub integrating 3 client applications, eliminating duplicate authentication systems and reducing onboarding friction, with zero disruption to the existing user base during live migration.

Redesigned authentication workflows across multiple web applications to integrate with a centralized identity provider, cutting per-app auth complexity and streamlining onboarding for new product integrations.
Consolidated billing infrastructure for multiple products into a unified platform, streamlining subscription management and payment processing.

Engineered custom native bridge modules in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android) to integrate proprietary smart-scale SDKs with a React Native (Expo) app, enabling real-time body composition tracking unavailable in any existing JS library.
Integrated Apple Health (HealthKit) and Android Health Connect to sync biometric data into cross-platform fitness progress dashboards.
Built and maintained a cross-platform ticketing system (React web + React Native iOS/Android) with a shared library of 15+ reusable UI components used across 2 products.

projects.title: ClimbIRL
projects.tagline: Gamified productivity: turn real-life tasks into an RPG
projects.description: I built and published this full-stack app to Google Play on my own. Users earn XP, level up, keep streaks, unlock achievements and climb global leaderboards by completing real-life tasks.
highlights: Timezone-aware gamification engine with a 20-level ranking system, atomic achievement unlocks and a rewarded AdMob token economy.
Google Gemini 2.5 Flash verifies task completion from photos; FCM delivers scheduled, timezone-sensitive push notifications.
Dockerized Node.js/TypeScript backend deployed to Oracle Cloud through a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.
3D interactive marketing site built with Next.js 16, Three.js (R3F) and Framer Motion.

projects.title: ArcadeVerse 3D
projects.tagline: Ad-free hyper-casual 3D minigame hub for Android
projects.description: A card-based launcher in Unity 6 that hosts self-contained 3D arcade games. All of them share one lightweight framework for scene launching, scoring, saves, audio and touch input.
highlights: Zero prefabs and zero art assets: every model, material, sprite and UI screen is generated procedurally at runtime from primitives and signed-distance shapes.
Evolution Runner: math gates (+5, x2, -3, ÷2) grow your power and evolve an aircraft rig from bare fuselage to glowing starship.
Bridge Race: collect colour-matched blocks to build your lane upward while racing two AI bots.
Mobile performance budget: 60 FPS, under 100 batches per scene and under a 70 MB APK (URP, IL2CPP, ARM64).

projects.title: My Money Tracker
projects.tagline: Private, on-device expense tracking from bank SMS
projects.description: A native Android finance app that turns bank SMS into a categorized spending ledger. It runs entirely on-device, so no transaction data ever leaves the phone.
highlights: SMS parser extracts amount, merchant, account and date from bank messages, and ignores personal and promotional texts.
On-device AI categorization with Google's Gemma 2B via MediaPipe LLM Inference. The model downloads on demand and stays in secure storage.
Recurring-payment detection, analytics charts, and a Jetpack Glance home-screen spending widget.
WorkManager spending digests, an app lock, Play in-app updates and an R8-shrunk release build.

projects.title: Habit Password Vault
projects.tagline: Encrypted password manager + focus habits, on Android & Windows
projects.description: A cross-platform Flutter vault that stores credentials with field-level encryption. It also helps build better digital habits with a website blocker and offline-time tracking.
highlights: Field-level AES encryption over SQLite, biometric unlock, clipboard auto-clear guard and encrypted backups with import/export.
Native Android Autofill service, a built-in TOTP authenticator with QR scanning, and a password-health audit.
Peer-to-peer Wi-Fi sync between devices, plus a Windows desktop build that launches at startup.
Automated release pipeline with GitHub Actions version bumps.

projects.title: Secure Room
projects.tagline: Virtual data rooms for sharing sensitive company documents
projects.description: A Flutter client and a TypeScript/Express backend for companies to manage secure rooms, invite users and share confidential documents, with every access audited.
highlights: Modular Express 5 + MongoDB API with company, user, room, document, subscription and audit-log domains.
JWT auth, Cloudinary document uploads via Multer, and Mailjet transactional emails.
In-app PDF viewing with screenshot and screen-recording protection, plus deep-link invites.
Feature-first Flutter architecture with Bloc, Dio and Hive.

projects.title: TrackItToo
projects.description: A feature-rich Flutter habit tracker with daily check-ins, automatic step counting, reminders and visual progress reports.
highlights: Email OTP authentication and a biometric app lock (Face ID / fingerprint).
Integrated pedometer, and smart reminders through FCM and local notifications.
Interactive weekly and monthly analytics with fl_chart.
Offline-first persistence with Hive and Bloc/Cubit state management.

projects.title: Full Stack E-Commerce
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with a product catalogue, cart management, user authentication and secure end-to-end checkout.
highlights: Braintree payment gateway integration for secure transactions.
RESTful Express/Node.js API backed by MongoDB for fast product queries and order processing.
Responsive React + Bootstrap storefront.

projects.title: Realtime Code Editor
projects.description: A collaborative editor where several developers join a room and co-author code in real time.
highlights: Socket.io rooms keep every connected editor in sync with minimal latency.
React frontend served from a Node/Express server.
